name: Soultaker
source:
Death! Oblivion! The End! It comes for us all!

And professional Shaman, Renny of the Century Cedar is here to ease all your worries about the great beyond! With her ability to walk in and out of the spirit realm, Renny can personally guarantee where your soul will go after dying. 

As a door-to-door afterlife sales-witch, she holds decades of experience conversing with all creatures, beings, and persons of magical ability. Knowing someone is not only seasoned in witchcraft for all living beings, but can rig the odds in your favor of going to where YOU want to go when you pass on. 

Can you afford not to hire her? None of us are getting out of life without dying after all! So why not know exactly where you'll go! Peace of mind and direct spiritual guidance is just a quick letter away! 

[From [url=https://tj-lounge.itch.io/soul-taker]itch.io[/url]]
